tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Shows the credit balance of this account in USD, what this key spent today, its daily spend cap, and the price of each tool. Paid tools spend this balance; when it runs out, ask a person to add credit with buy_credits_link, or pay with add_credit (a business purchase).

tools.name: buy_credits_link
tools.description: Returns a card checkout link for this account. A person opens it and pays there. This tool never charges anything by itself. Tax, where it applies, is added at checkout.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_url · Private data: scan_repo · Public sink: publish_status · Destructive: scan_repo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_url · Private data: scan_repo · Public sink: publish_status · Destructive: scan_repo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
